title: Physics-informed and event-aware forecasting of ammonia emissions in aerobic chicken manure composting bioreactors: A PINN-PatchTST-GPR framework with symbolic dynamic extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.18614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting ammonia (NH3) concentrations during aerobic chicken manure composting provides critical feedforward signals for intelligent aeration. However, the concurrence of long-term biochemical evolution and intermittent forced-aeration pulses poses significant modeling hurdles across steady baselines, transient surges, and risk quantification. Existing data-driven models lack physical consistency, while mechanistic kinetic models struggle with environmental disturbances. To bridge this gap, we propose PINN-PatchTST-GPR, a physics-informed neuro-symbolic forecasting framework. Validated on a 28-day composting campaign across six vertical bioreactors, the framework couples a channel-independent PatchTST backbone with macroscopic kinetic constraints, dynamic physical bounds, and a Gaussian process regression (GPR) event specialist. translated_title: 基于物理信息与事件感知的好氧鸡粪堆肥生物反应器氨气排放预测：一种具有符号动态提取功能的PINN-PatchTST-GPR框架
translated_abstract: 在好氧鸡粪堆肥过程中预测氨气（NH3）浓度为智能曝气提供了关键的前馈信号。然而，长期生化演化与间歇性强制曝气脉冲的并发，给稳态基线、瞬态激增以及风险量化的建模带来了重大挑战。现有的数据驱动模型缺乏物理一致性，而机理动力学模型则难以应对环境扰动。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了PINN-PatchTST-GPR——一个物理信息神经符号预测框架。该框架在为期28天、涵盖六个垂直生物反应器的堆肥实验中得到验证，它将通道独立的PatchTST骨干网络与宏观动力学约束、动态物理界限以及高斯过程回归（GPR）事件专家模型相结合。多通道传感器数据流驱动离散微分方程残差和非负性约束……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种物理信息神经符号预测框架PINN-PatchTST-GPR，通过将通道独立的PatchTST骨干网络与宏观动力学约束、动态物理界限及高斯过程回归事件专家模型相结合，实现了好氧鸡粪堆肥过程中氨气排放的精准预测，为智能曝气控制提供前馈信号。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PINN-PatchTST-GPR, a physics-informed neuro-symbolic forecasting framework that couples a channel-independent PatchTST backbone with macroscopic kinetic constraints, dynamic physical bounds, and a Gaussian process regression event specialist to accurately predict ammonia emissions in aerobic chicken manure composting, providing critical feedforward signals for intelligent aeration control.
